# Cleaning and Repair works scheduled for main Merlion statue at Merlion Park

27 October 2026

The Singapore Tourism Board would like to inform the public that the main Merlion statue at Merlion Park will be undergoing cleaning and repair works from 24 November to 26 November.

Singapore, 27 October 2026 – The Singapore Tourism Board would like to inform the public that the main Merlion statue at the Merlion Park will be undergoing cleaning and repair works from 24 to 26 November 2026.
